anchor_value: CAD 13,261,059 par requiring explicit USD principal conversion

findings.detail: KeyData Associates debt has source par in CAD 13,261,059, but principal_amount_usd is blank and needs an explicit USD converted principal for par analytics.

rationale: Class 1 single-cell review. The raw SOI row for KeyData Associates Inc. shows a non-USD par/shares value, CAD 13,261,059, while the flagged extracted principal_amount_usd value is blank. Because FX01 requires explicit USD conversion for non-USD debt principal, the blank USD principal is a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
